name: Patched Dinghy
description: A leaky rowing boat with a rusty outboard: cheap, small and nobody's pride.
special: the cheapest boat; open hull with no cabin, so no windows glow at night (only the bow lantern)

name: Classic Sloop
description: A white wooden sailboat with brass portholes and a red-striped mainsail.
special: tallest boat (mast 1.08 above the waterline) with a deep keel (0.25 below); a red pennant flies at the masthead

name: Red Runabout
description: A low deep-V speedboat with twin outboards and a racing stripe.
special: the fastest boat; low and open, so it has no flag and no windows that glow (the nav light is the lamp)

name: Little Tug
description: A stubby red harbour tug with a cream wheelhouse, round portholes and a striped funnel.
special: the standard boat: a stubby harbour tug drawn at 0.8 of the size it was modelled (hull about 0.84 long and 0.34 wide); its wheelhouse windows and portholes glow warm when the lamp is on, a teal pennant flies from the mast and its funnel smokes

name: Gilded Yacht
description: A navy and gold motor yacht with two decks, a hot tub and chrome railings.
special: the most expensive boat; its window bands and portholes glow warm when the lamp is on, and a gold flag flies at the stern
